facade.description: In over his head in a meat-grinder Mega-Corp role that he wanted, but is now desperately trying to survive.

secret.description: Always good with machines, but excels at figuring out the specific sequences of 'magic words' (prompt-injection/social engineering) that make the city's AI systems give up their dirtiest secrets or cause Brood(TM) drones to unexpectedly go offline.
